scan.madvise: MADV_SEQUENTIAL + MADV_HUGEPAGE on all column mmaps

block_classification.all_pass: max_date <= threshold → aggregate entire block without per-row date check
block_classification.partial: scan rows individually with per-row predicate

key_encoding.description: Use a 256-entry uint8_t lookup table for each of returnflag and linestatus. returnflag: A→0, N→1, R→2. linestatus: F→0, O→1. Combined key = rf_idx * 2 + ls_idx. Max index = 5, allocate 6 slots.

accumulators_per_group.sum_disc_price: double — plain += accumulation. Compute as extendedprice * (1.0 - discount)
accumulators_per_group.sum_charge: double — plain += accumulation. Compute as extendedprice * (1.0 - discount) * (1.0 + tax)

aggregation.struct_layout: CRITICAL: The Accum struct MUST contain EXACTLY these 6 fields: double sum_qty, double sum_base_price, double sum_disc_price, double sum_charge, double sum_discount, int64_t count. Total = 48 bytes. Do NOT add any Kahan compensation fields. Do NOT define any KAHAN_ADD macro. Do NOT use compensated summation anywhere. Use simple += for ALL accumulations.
aggregation.avg_computation: deferred to finalize: avg = sum / count

parallelism.schedule: static — work is nearly perfectly balanced at 98.8% selectivity. Static scheduling eliminates dynamic scheduling overhead (atomic counter contention across 64 threads).
parallelism.merge: sum thread-local accumulator arrays (6 slots each) into global result
parallelism.thread_local_layout: Allocate per-thread accumulators as array of cache-line-aligned ThreadSlot structs. Each ThreadSlot contains Accum[6]. Use alignas(64) on ThreadSlot to prevent false sharing. Zero-initialize with memset before scan.

data_structures.aggregation: fixed_array(6 slots per thread, indexed by compact key)
data_structures.thread_local_accumulators: std::vector<ThreadSlot> where ThreadSlot is alignas(64) with Accum[6]. Each Accum is 48 bytes (5 doubles + 1 int64_t, NO compensation fields).

output.sort_strategy: trivial — iterate compact keys 0..5 in order, output non-empty groups

optimization_notes: Category A+C. Root cause: iter_1 code still used Kahan summation (KAHAN_ADD macro, compensation fields in Accum struct) despite the plan directing removal — adding 8 extra FP ops/row and bloating the struct from 48 to 64 bytes. Also used schedule(dynamic,4) causing atomic contention across 64 threads for only 916 blocks. Fixes: (1) REMOVE all Kahan summation — use plain += for all accumulators, struct drops to 48 bytes (5 doubles + 1 int64_t), (2) switch to static scheduling since 98.8% selectivity means near-perfect load balance, (3) compile with -O3 -march=native -funroll-loops for best autovectorization of the inner accumulation loop. Target: sub-31ms by eliminating ~470M wasted FP ops and reducing scheduling overhead.
